description: Legger en Werkingsgebieden Waterkeringen Vastgesteld Waterschap Rivierenland is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Waterschap Rivierenland legt essentiële informatie waaraan de dijken (waterkeringen) moeten voldoen qua ligging, afmeting, vorm en constructie vast in de legger. Deze kaartlaag bevat de vastgestelde legger van de waterkeringen van Waterschap Rivierenland. Deze zijn vastgesteld op 2 september 2025. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are legger, waterkeringen, werkingsgebieden. It offers 2 resource(s) in WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
